lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible on the central flank. A primary cluster of approximately 20 large spots is organized into four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal carinae at the precise coordinates of the high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible. The primary ridge at the upper third of the flank shows a high-contrast luminance gradient, with pixel intensity peaking on the dorsal edge and tapering into a shadow-filled trough on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs is present within the dorsal fin silhouette. Spots are irregularly distributed with higher clustering observed near the trailing edge compared to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: At least four elongated, white, thread-like structures are visible trailing from the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin, consistent with parasitic copepod attachment or biological tagging remnants.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-density micro-spot patterning is visible on the rostrum and cranial region, showing a transition from dense, randomly distributed points to the organized macro-blob rows of the lateral flank.
